subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept this broad literal `agents.list[].env` contract across CLI, exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP subprocesses, or narrow the feature to a smaller env/identity/SecretRef surface?
rationale: The implementation is concrete, but automation cannot choose the permanent public config and security boundary for child-process environment injection.

options.title: Accept Broad Env Contract
options.body: Approve this cross-runtime `agents.list[].env` shape, then require rebase and green exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Exec/SecretRef
options.body: Use a smaller surface such as the maintainer-labeled work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96309 if broad child env is too risky.

options.title: Pause For Identity Design
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want a first-class identity binding or another product-specific contract instead of generic env injection.

recommendation.title: Accept Broad Env Contract
recommendation.body: Approve this cross-runtime `agents.list[].env` shape, then require rebase and green exact-head checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer is tied to the earlier implementation feedback and recent config/exec history for the same requested behavior.
